messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — I've got a hotfix ready for the tokenizer truncation regression. Patch 3.1.5. Hits ~5% failure on long prompts in staging. Need expedited approval for a late-window deploy tonight (00:30–01:00 UTC). Canary plan below. @Sam O'Neill @Arjun Rao please weigh in.
ops-bot: alert: regression-detect job #tkz-527 flagged spike in truncation errors 18:42 UTC. Noise score 0.82.
Sam O'Neill: reading. quick Q: is this only affecting hosted inference or dedicated pools too?
Maya Patel: hosted API only. Dedicated customers unaffected because they pin older tokenizer config. We'll pin 3.1.5 to hosted and keep dedicated at 3.1.4 for now.
Lia Chen: skimmed diff. LGTM on fix. We'll need release notes and the exact validation checklist before approval: e2e prompt sanity, regression eval on 10k prompts, and kv-cache sanity.
Arjun Rao: I can approve if there are clear rollback gates. Propose metric gates: (1) absolute error-rate for truncation <= 1% during canary, (2) for any region p50/p95 latency increase <= 40ms, (3) 5xx rate not increase > 1.5x baseline. If any gate trips, auto rollback to 3.1.4.
Tony G.: oncall availability: I can be oncall for the window. ops will monitor EU and US edges. Confirming midnight maintenance window overlap with infra maintenance? If so we might need to defer.
Maya Patel: window confirmed 00:30–01:00 UTC (short window to limit customer impact). Oncall: Tony + Lia. Rollback plan: immediate pin revert + traffic shift to fallback pool. Arjun, does that meet your criteria?
Arjun Rao: yes. Also add a synthetic traffic check: run 1 minute of high-length prompts at 10 rps post-canary to validate KV cache behavior.
Sam O'Neill: approve. I'll +1 once release notes and the small smoke script land in this thread.
Lia Chen: approve. posting release note draft: "Fix: Tokenizer truncation on long sequences that caused malformed outputs. Affected: hosted API long-prompt paths. Action: deployment 3.1.5; will rollback if error-rate spikes."
Maya Patel: added smoke script to ops repo: gist link (internal). Smoke steps:
```
# smoke.sh
for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d @long_prompt.json $HOST/generate || echo fail; sleep 1; done
```
Run during canary and watch error counts.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy: 3.1.5 -> hosted-api, canary 10% (15m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (gradual). Start time 00:35 UTC. To bypass normal 48h review, approval_count=2 recorded.
Sam O'Neill: ack, will run the synthetic check during canary.
Tony G.: ack, oncall monitoring. I'll watch 5xx and latency dashboards and respond if gate trips.
Maya Patel: thanks all. Kicking off at 00:35. Will post progress and logs here.
deploy-bot: canary started — 10% traffic routed to 3.1.5. timestamp 2765442000.
ops-bot: metric-packet: truncation_errors: baseline 0.3% -> current 0.55%; p95 latency delta +22ms; 5xxs +0.6x. All gates PASS.
Sam O'Neill: running synthetic high-length run now.
Sam O'Neill: synthetic run completed: 60/60 OK, no malformed outputs observed.
Maya Patel: canary healthy at 10% -> promoting to 50% per plan.
deploy-bot: promoted to 50% traffic. timestamp 2765443600.
ops-bot: metric-packet: truncation_errors 0.48%; p95 +28ms; 5xxs +0.7x. Still PASS.
Arjun Rao: monitoring looks good from my side. p95 within threshold.
Tony G.: no alerts on infra, logs look clean.
Maya Patel: promoting to 100% and finalizing release notes. Rolling pin in hosted pool.
deploy-bot: promotion to 100% complete. timestamp 2765445000. Release tag: v3.1.5-hosted. Change window closed.
Maya Patel: final note — post-deploy follow-up: run full regression eval tomorrow and flag any semantic regressions. Thanks for the quick approvals :tada:
